states.name: defcon-4-europe-closed
states.description: DEFCON 4; USSR to act holding Fidel (2 ops). West Germany US 3 (Europe: closed to coups and realignments at DEFCON 4) and Iran US 2 (open).

states.name: defcon-3-asia-closed
states.description: DEFCON 3; USSR to act holding Fidel (2 ops). Japan US 3 (Asia: closed from DEFCON 3) and Iran US 2 (open).

states.name: defcon-2-middle-east-closed
states.description: DEFCON 2; USSR to act holding Fidel (2 ops). Iran US 2, USSR 1 (the Middle East: closed at DEFCON 2, yet the USSR may still place influence there) and Morocco US 1 (Africa: open, not a battleground).

states.name: mil-ops-from-coup
states.description: DEFCON 5, USSR 4 Military Ops, US 1; USSR to act holding Fidel (2 ops). Morocco US 1 - any coup there adds its 2 ops to the USSR's track (capped at 5).
